summary: Shows disabling diff output for a task with `diff: false`, because `--diff` can reveal sensitive information such as secret config contents.
questions: How do I stop --diff from printing a secret file's contents?
Can I turn off diff for just one task?

answer_card.title: Disable diff on a task
answer_card.answer_md:
Because `--diff` can reveal sensitive data, set `diff: false` on the task:

```yaml
- name: No diff reported when the file changes
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: secret.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/secret.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0600'
  diff: false
```
